name: opp115_do_not_track_legal_bench
description: A legal-text benchmark focused on "Do Not Track" and related privacy-policy provisions. It measures models' ability to understand, classify, and retrieve legal/privacy statements relevant to tracking and consent. Typical uses include classification, information extraction, and semantic-search or embedding evaluation in the legal domain.
reputation: Included in MTEB collections, this is a niche but useful dataset for legal NLP and embedding evaluation.
